2607.27773.title: ChronoMem: Version Control and Semantic Rollback for Large Language Model Agent Memory
2607.27773.paper_summary: LLM agents increasingly rely on long-term memory to support multi-session interaction and personalization. However, existing agent memory systems are designed around forward-only evolution, continuously accumulating, consolidating, and overwriting knowledge, with no principled mechanism to inspect, version, or revert prior states. This makes agents brittle under corrections, concept drift, and memory corruption, particularly after they have already been exposed to subsequent information. We present ChronoMem, a semantic version-control layer for agentic memory integrated into the production-ready, open-source Agent Development Kit by Google. ChronoMem commits whole-memory snapshots at each memory write, maintains structured version histories, and supports natural-language rollback requests by mapping undo intents to concrete historical versions through hybrid lexical and semantic retrieval, rank fusion, and reranking. We further introduce a post-exposure evaluation protocol that tests whether an agent can behave counterfactually after rollback by answering queries and summarizing history as if future updates had never occurred. On long-horizon conversational benchmarks augmented with evolving memory states and rollback tasks, ChronoMem substantially improves rollback-consistent question answering and history summarization relative to prompt-only and retrieval-only baselines, while achieving strong performance in semantic version selection. To our knowledge, ChronoMem is the first open-source system and benchmark for systematic semantic global memory rollback in LLM agents.
2607.27773.paper_summary_zh: LLM 代理越來越依賴長期記憶來支持多會話互動和個性化。<lb/>然而，現有的代理記憶系統是圍繞單向演變設計的，持續累積、整合和覆蓋知識，沒有原則性的機制來檢查、版本控制或恢復先前的狀態。<lb/>這使得代理在修正、概念漂移和記憶損壞下變得脆弱，特別是在它們已經接觸到後續信息之後。<lb/>我們提出了 ChronoMem，一個集成到 Google 的生產就緒開源代理開發工具包中的代理記憶的語義版本控制層。<lb/>ChronoMem 在每次記憶寫入時提交整個記憶快照，維護結構化版本歷史，並通過混合詞彙和語義檢索、排名融合和重新排名來支持自然語言回滾請求，將撤銷意圖映射到具體的歷史版本。<lb/>我們進一步介紹了一種後曝光評估協議，測試代理在回滾後是否能夠反事實行為，通過回答查詢和總結歷史，仿佛未來的更新從未發生過。<lb/>在增強了演變記憶狀態和回滾任務的長期對話基準上，ChronoMem 相較於僅提示和僅檢索的基準，顯著改善了回滾一致的問題回答和歷史總結，同時在語義版本選擇上達到了強勁的表現。<lb/>據我們所知，ChronoMem 是第一個開源系統和基準，用於 LLM 代理中系統性的語義全局記憶回滾。
